description: M17 reference target: bare skin realistic adult male anatomy from supplied Veilbound character sheet; keep modest neutral undershorts, no helmet armor or weapon. Studio-only model. All worker outputs manual-review-only; no untested gameplay replacement.

tasks.goal: Build the NEW HumanAnatomy.java studio-only unarmored adult male figure. Target anatomically believable head-to-body 1:7.5 ratio, rib cage, scapula, shoulder deltoids, elbow, hips, quadriceps, knees, calves, individual palms/fingers and toes. Source remains original and locally generated, not copies of proprietary game/movie meshes. Neutral modest shorts, natural skin. Separate model from armor. Preserve all existing game meshes and Android ES2.

Develop warm natural-looking skin material, undertones and controlled skin roughness with deterministic original procedural textures. No shiny silver skin, no texture sliding. Keep existing steel, leather, cloth, stone maps and tests intact.

Design realistic neutral unarmored human idle pose, shoulder-to-elbow articulation and planted foot contacts; preserve combat animation interfaces and old armored gameplay hero. Reference human gait with weight shift, heel roll and torso counterrotation.

Expose NEW HUMAN BASE model as separate Model Atelier selection with orbit zoom front side back and UV/material inspection. Never replace playable armored Bellwarden or remove existing viewer entries.
Plan stable connected zone streaming framework for a future 250-zone world, no giant initial asset load; maintain deterministic generation and preserve current arena.
Plan enemies with full-body telegraphed attacks: windup commitment contact recovery, heavy slash thrust overhead grab and ranged magic; do not alter gameplay until test validation.
